subject: ggmap ggplot legend text not showing

messages.author: 146c5031f31e4913
messages.subject: ggmap ggplot legend text not showing
parts:
Hi all, 

I've been banging my head against this one and I'm probably just not seeing something small. I'm just trying to figure out how to get the church type names to also show up in the legend area,

Could someone help set me straight?

library(ggmap)
library(ggplot2)

dat <- structure(list(lat = c(47.99901,47.67795,49.39875,48.25921), long = c(7.842104,9.173238,8.672434,7.813998),
                 church = c("Catholic", "Protestant", "Catholic", "Protestant")), 
                 .Names = c("lat", "long", "church"), row.names = c(NA,  -2L), class = "data.frame")
  
test <- get_map('stuttgart, germany', zoom = 7, color="bw", maptype= 'roadmap', source="google")

testmap <- ggmap(test, extent='device')

(testmap + geom_point(aes(x=long, y=lat, colour=church), size = 4, data = dat))

Thanks. 

Jake

On 11/30/2012 8:11 AM, Jake Russ wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I've been banging my head against this one and I'm probably just not seeing
> something small. I'm just trying to figure out how to get the church type
> names to also show up in the legend area,
>
> Could someone help set me straight?
>
> library(ggmap)
> library(ggplot2)
>
> dat <- structure(list(lat = c(47.99901,47.67795,49.39875,48.25921), long =
> c(7.842104,9.173238,8.672434,7.813998),
> church = c("Catholic", "Protestant", "Catholic",
> "Protestant")),
> .Names = c("lat", "long", "church"), row.names = c(NA,
> -2L), class = "data.frame")
>
> test <- get_map('stuttgart, germany', zoom = 7, color="bw", maptype=
> 'roadmap', source="google")
>
> testmap <- ggmap(test, extent='device')

The problem is here. By setting extent='device', ggmap adds a
theme_nothing to the plot which suppresses all the text parts of the
legend (by setting the text root to element_blank()). Use either
"normal" or "panel" for the extent argument and then you can turn off
parts you don't want with a theme yourself.

> (testmap + geom_point(aes(x=long, y=lat, colour=church), size = 4, data =
> dat))
>
> Thanks.
>
> Jake
>

Oregon Health & Science University
